The '''Lower Prison Outer Transport''' was the modern designation for the [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] transporter that was located in a cave off of the [[ruined Rakata machine chamber]] in [[the Tomb]], an ancient Rakata [[Prison/Legends|prison]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Lower Prison Outer Transport is a Imperial-restricted transporter in the Tomb on the planet Belsavis in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
